content.title: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) to Deploy Drones for Flood Monitoring
content.caption: The Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) plans to deploy drones across all 15 zones of Chennai to monitor flood-prone areas during the Northeast monsoon.

slides.heading: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) to Deploy Drones for Flood Monitoring
slides.text: The Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) plans to deploy drones across all 15 zones of Chennai to monitor flood-prone areas during the Northeast monsoon.

slides.heading: Deployment of Drones
slides.text: The GCC plans to deploy one drone and a trained operating team in each of the city's 15 zones for 30 days, covering the northern, central, and southern regions.

slides.heading: Monitoring Vulnerable Locations
slides.text: The drones will be stationed in each zone to help officials assess conditions on the ground and identify locations requiring attention.
